Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4 and mechanism_of_action classified as CHELATING AGENT. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, and to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target chembl_id as target_chembl_id, and target pref_name as target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
